info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Corporate Finance By Param1-spec
info.description: The Corporate Finance Update API allows users to modify specific aspects of corporate tax advisory services by utilizing a unique identifier. This functionality supports financial professionals in managing and updating client financial data efficiently. Typically consumed by financial advisors and corporate finance teams, this API ensures that users can tailor services to meet individual client needs. By providing a streamlined way to process updates, it enhances the overall service delivery in corporate finance operations.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of the Corporate Tax Advisory resource identified by RES-100045. You can modify specific fields as required to ensure the advisory information is current and accurate.
